mapper.select: SELECT id, operation_detail, user_id, event_time, created_at FROM t_system_audit_log WHERE operation = 'FIELD_CONVERSION' AND target_type = 'FEEDBACK' AND target_id = CAST(#{targetId} AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_as_cs ORDER BY COALESCE(event_time, created_at), id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_system_audit_log(user_id, operation, target_type, target_id, operation_detail) VALUES(#{userId}, #{operation}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, CAST(#{detailJson} AS JSON))
